style.backgroundSystem: dark charcoal-grey studio gradient #4A4E55 for model screens and clean off-white #F5F6F7 seamless for info, grid and trust screens
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons and small numbered circle badges in a single navy accent #1F3A5F
style.lightingSystem: soft large-softbox studio lighting, front-left key with gentle fill and a subtle shoulder rim, soft contact shadows grounding the figure, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium tailored suiting visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of dark charcoal-grey studio gradient #4A4E55, heather-grey suit tone #AEB6BF, clean off-white #F5F6F7 and one deep navy accent #1F3A5F with charcoal text #2D2D2D; neutral temperature with soft large-softbox lighting, front-left key with gentle fill, subtle shoulder rim and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headline type only; consistent rounded rectangular label chips and thin-line numbered circle badges; clean premium tailoring photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight three-quarter hero angle and consistent garment scale with clean drape; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight three-quarter hero angle and consistent garment scale across the set, clean unexploded drape, faces cropped or turned away so the tailoring stays the subject
style.surfaceSystem: matte charcoal studio floor #3A3D42 and light matte board #EDEEF0 for flat lays
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headline type only, charcoal #2D2D2D text on off-white or deep navy #1F3A5F chips
